incidents.name: Degraded instance launches and terminations in us-east-3

incident_updates.body:
**Severity Level:** [Low]

Our public cloud experienced a network configuration issue in Lambda Cloud. 

 

Region:US-EAST-3

Impact: October 28, 2026

Start: 15:40 UTC

End: 16:50 UTC

Duration: 1 hour 10 minutes

During that time, users may have seen fewer instances available to launch in us-east-3, and instance termination requests that were accepted but not completed.

Running instances were not affected, and we have successfully repaired the issue. We're continuing to monitor. If you were affected or have questions, please contact Lambda Support.

**Severity Level:** Medium

DAL01 - COLO Internet Connectivity Disruption (Upstream Provider)

We are currently investigating a loss of internet connectivity affecting colocation customers in our DAL01 (Dallas) facility. The disruption is due to a down Dedicated Internet Access (DIA) circuit with one of our upstream providers.

Customers with IP addresses in the **38.147.81.0/24** range may be unable to send or receive traffic over the affected circuit.

We have opened a ticket with the upstream provider and are actively working with them to restore service. We will provide another update as soon as additional information becomes available.

Thank you for your patience and understanding during this time.
